sources.locator: Baseline quota; plan tiers; AI credits and overages; not supported
sources.finding: Quota refresh per tier (Ultra and Pro every five hours, with weekly rate limits; other plans weekly); Pro and Ultra can use purchased AI credits, which "are consumed at standard Gemini Enterprise consumption pricing"; AI Credit Overages setting Never (wait until the baseline quota refreshes) or Always; BYOK/BYO endpoint for extra rate limits and custom-contract org tiers not supported. sources.title: Remote Control
sources.locator: Requirements; actions; notifications; multiple machines; disconnects
sources.finding: Browser dashboard at antigravity.google.com drives desktop sessions and CLI instances: view active conversations, start new agent tasks, review implementation plans and inspect artifacts; tool confirmations and clarifying questions can be answered from the terminal or the remote UI; settings cannot be changed from the web and no agent stop action is described. No native mobile app; the web app can be installed on a home screen for push notifications. CLI interactive mode (/remote-control, --remote-control) and a headless daemon (agy remote-control start) registered as a systemd user service (Linux), LaunchAgent (macOS) or Scheduled Task (Windows). Daemon logs: journalctl on Linux, ~/Library/Logs/antigravity-cli-daemon.log on macOS, cli-*.log under %USERPROFILE%\.gemini\antigravity-cli\log on Windows. Background tasks keep running while the host stays online.

sources.title: Teamwork

sources.title: Custom subagents
sources.finding: Markdown subagents with model inherit/flash/pro; invoke_subagent with inherit/branch(worktree)/share workspace; background and concurrent; messaging by conversation ID, and a parent can interrupt a running subagent by sending a message; /agents panel is a "live checklist of all active, completed, killed, or failed background agents" with role, state and current step; subagents inherit the parent's "allowed terminal command prefixes, file read/write directory scopes, and sandbox settings"; approval requests bubble up to the main UI or subagent panel; Alt+J jumps to the next subagent awaiting approval; killed subagents' transcripts remain readable in JSONL logs; nesting capped at 10.

sources.title: Projects

No webhooks, external triggers or overlap handling described.

sources.finding: Data collection can be opted out in Settings; using third-party software to access Antigravity violates the Terms; "Wrapping agy inside third-party coding agents or applications, or automating account rotation, is not supported under consumer plans"; limited to personal accounts in approved geographies and users 18+; support answer points to community channels on the Support page.

sources.title: Antigravity terms
sources.finding: Interactions used to evaluate, develop and improve Google products; Google staff may review; opt-out in settings; deletion by email request; Gemini Enterprise users governed by administrator terms; third-party model terms apply.

sources.title: Teamwork
sources.locator: Roles; communication; inspectable delegation; live progress
sources.finding: Current /teamwork command, available on paid plans in app and CLI, documents Project Orchestrator, Explorers, Workers and review gates, exclusive file ownership, project plan/progress artifacts and retained logs. No longer named /teamwork-preview.

sources.title: Custom subagents
sources.finding: Markdown subagents with model inherit/flash/pro; invoke_subagent with inherit/branch(worktree)/share workspace; background and concurrent; messaging by conversation ID, and a parent can interrupt a running subagent by sending a message; /agents panel is a "live checklist of all active, completed, killed, or failed background agents" with role, state and current step; subagents inherit the parent's "allowed terminal command prefixes, file read/write directory scopes, and sandbox settings"; approval requests bubble up to the main UI or subagent panel; Alt+J jumps to the next subagent awaiting approval; killed subagents' transcripts remain readable in JSONL logs; nesting capped at 10.

sources.title: Projects
sources.finding: Projects group multi-folder workspaces, settings and conversation histories; folders can be "Local folders: A folder that doesn't have Git configured" or local Git checkouts; Local mode "works directly in your active local folders or Git checkouts" and New worktree mode creates a Git worktree per conversation; /fork between projects.

sources.title: Lifecycle hooks
sources.finding: PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PreInvocation/PostInvocation/Stop hooks via hooks.json in 2.0, CLI and IDE, used "to enforce rules, execute linters, or capture diagnostics"; the schema example registers a PostToolUse "my-linter-hook" running ./scripts/lint.sh after run_command; hook timeout defaults to 30 seconds; PreToolUse can deny or ask; Stop can force the agent to continue.

sources.title: Antigravity SDK
sources.finding: Python SDK (pip install google-antigravity) described as a "secure, stateful runtime harness" for agents powered by Antigravity and Gemini: tools, MCP, subagents, skills, hooks, policies, structured output, session persistence; Gemini API key or Vertex authentication; links to the managed Gemini API agent. No stability label on this page.

sources.title: SDK local models
sources.finding: SDK can run local models via LiteRT or OpenAI-compatible servers (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM); the page says local models run without an API key or internet connection, but the LiteRT setup needs a one-time model checkpoint download (about 16.8 GB example); apps and CLI not covered.

sources.title: Headless mode
sources.finding: Headless docs now state default no time limit; --print-timeout defaults to 0s, meaning unlimited. The earlier five-minute contradiction is resolved. Print mode emits structured result/status events.

sources.title: Feature overview
sources.locator: Scheduled tasks; VCS panel; worktrees; Remote Control
sources.finding: Feature overview now documents Google-managed Remote Agents that continue while the local machine sleeps or is offline, alongside local Remote Control. Scheduled tasks are now called Automations.

sources.title: Slash commands overview
sources.finding: Command table: /boost, /teamwork-preview, /goal, /plan, /grill-me, /learn, /plugin, /schedule ("one-time timer or recurring cron job"), /browser, /btw; /usage, /credits, /codesearch, /diff, /resume, /permissions appear only in the sidebar. No git, PR, issue, share or export command.

sources.title: Execution modes
sources.finding: CLI modes default (inline diff review), accept-edits and plan; in plan mode the agent investigates files using read-only tools (code_search, grep_search, view_file); sandbox is a permission setting not a mode.

sources.title: Resume command
sources.finding: /resume session picker, agy -c, import of 2.0 desktop threads with history, context and tool trajectories; crash recovery not covered.

sources.title: Authenticate
sources.finding: Moved authentication page documents personal Google, enterprise/Cloud, ADC, keyring, remote SSH OAuth and Gemini API key routes; /logout and custom Gemini endpoint configuration. Platform installation is covered by current quickstart/download docs.

sources.title: Remote Agents
sources.locator: Availability; Remote Agents vs Remote Control; CLI setup and limitations
sources.finding: Remote Agents gradually rolls out to Pro/Ultra personal Google accounts, excluding free/Plus/business. App, web and CLI 1.4.12+ reach Google-managed environments that continue while the user machine sleeps. Remote projects attach repos/Drive/files. Local plugins, skills, MCP and several CLI commands do not carry over.

sources.title: Remote Control
sources.locator: Antigravity CLI tab > Remote Control headless daemon > How the daemon runs (table)
sources.finding: Headless daemon registers as a systemd user service, LaunchAgent or Scheduled Task; table row 'Comes back by itself after a crash' is Yes on Linux and macOS and, on Windows, yes with up to three restart attempts, then at next boot or by re-running start. The web UI automatically tries to reconnect after network drops while host tasks keep running.

sources.title: Changelog
sources.locator: Antigravity App v2.14.0 (September 15, 2026) fixes; Antigravity CLI v1.2.1 (September 11, 2026) improvements
sources.finding: App v2.14.0 fixed a single transient service error ending a session; transient errors are now retried with backoff for about twelve minutes. CLI v1.2.1 retries transient genai.APIError failures (502/503/504, per-minute 429, mid-stream interruptions) in-process with exponential backoff, and unrecovered 503 and 429 responses surface clear user-facing error messages.

sources.title: Antigravity in Gemini Enterprise
sources.locator: Supported products note at top of page
sources.finding: Enterprise integration is supported for the Antigravity App, Antigravity CLI and Antigravity IDE extensions (VS Code, Visual Studio; JetBrains, Zed, Xcode, Eclipse in preview); the standalone Antigravity IDE is not supported for enterprise deployments.
